name: ethan-dkb
description: Durable Knowledge Bases — tools for collecting sources and querying them with provenance intact.

plugins.name: dkb
plugins.description: Build and query a durable, append-only knowledge base that answers only from your own sources, with full provenance.

plugins.name: dkb-demo
plugins.description: Pre-ingested demo knowledge bases for dkb: the LHC micro-black-hole safety debate, and the SABRE airline reservation system. Install alongside dkb to try the system without assembling a corpus first.
